title: November 2025
about: The 11 to 12 November 2025 storm: a G4 at Kp 9 minus, Dst about -217 nT. The sky at each moment is the archived Kp up to it and the G4 NOAA had classified the incoming storm as.

watch.note: NOAA SWPC had classified the incoming storm as G4

g4.note: Kp 8.67 in the 00 to 03 UTC block

records.happened: NOAA SWPC classified the incoming storm as G4 and warned grid operators ahead of it, across states north of the 45th parallel.
records.means: told the day before to get ready

records.happened: USGS recorded a G4; storms of this intensity do not usually interrupt transmission, and no outage was reported.
records.means: pointed at the equipment to watch, without predicting a blackout

records.happened: Positioning errors ran over ten metres for hours across the continental United States.
records.means: a hold for RTK survey work

records.happened: Auroral precipitation expanded across most of the continental United States, as far south as Florida, at Kp 9 minus.
records.means: told how far south it has actually been seen at this level

records.happened: No outage was reported at G4.
records.means: a household at G4 is not alarmed
